en.headline: 2 issues opened on openchamber plus 20 automated commits
en.summary: On 2026-10-09, sogeisetsu opened 2 issues on `openchamber/openchamber` and received 1 reply, with no pull requests, reviews, or releases. The first issue, `openchamber/openchamber` #4601 titled `[Bug] Switching model in the composer keeps the previous thinking level instead of the model's own default`, was opened at 08:59 UTC and later commented on by the user at 09:31 UTC; `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied at 09:19 UTC noting the issue is `fix-ready` and that `defaultVariant` is a single global profile setting applied to every model offering that variant id. The user also started 2 discussions on `openchamber/openchamber`: #4600 `[Idea] Let an extension expose something the agent can call, or document the file workflow` in the Extensions category, and #4599 `[Idea] Give agents a supported way to read and change OpenChamber settings (tool, CLI, or MCP)` in the Ideas category, both opened at 08:59 UTC with 0 comments so far. There were **0 own commits** in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, plus 20 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. No releases were published that day.
